✊ RPS

The timeless decision game: Rock crushes Scissors, Scissors cuts Paper, Paper covers Rock. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Choose Rock, Paper, or Scissors.
  2. The opponent simultaneously reveals their choice.
  3. Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beat Paper, Paper beats Rock.
  4. Play multiple rounds to test whether you can spot patterns.
  5. The AI's choice is effectively random — pure strategy has no edge.
